How Did Skin Color Become a Category?――「黒人」に歴史が乗るまで

Skin color is visible. But race is not simply skin color with a name. AABA, APA, Japanese geography research, and historical work on Japan show that racial categories were shaped by history, institutions, and power. 「人種は生物学的な箱ではないが、社会的には現実に作用する」という二層構造を整理する。
